title: Merge maintenance windows
hints: Pattern: sort then sweep. Once the windows are sorted by start, only the last merged window can overlap the next one.
sorted(windows) sorts tuples by start (then end) and returns a new list, so the input stays untouched.
For each window: if its start <= the end of the last merged window, extend that end with max(); otherwise append it as a new window.
Validate start <= end for every window before sorting, and raise ValueError on the first bad one.
